grade_and_subject.standards_system_name: B.E.S.T. Standards (Benchmarks for Excellent Student Thinking)

standards.text: Use knowledge of grade-appropriate phonics and word-analysis skills to decode words. a. Decode words with variable vowel teams (e.g., oo, ea, ou) and vowel diphthongs (e.g., oi, oy, ow). b. Decode regularly spelled two-syllable words with long and short vowels. c. Decode words with open (e.g., hi, baby, moment) and closed (e.g., bag, sunshine, chop) syllables and consonant -le (e.g., purple, circle, stumble). d. Decode words with common prefixes and suffixes. e. Decode words with silent letter combinations (e.g., knight, comb, island, ghost).

key_learning_outcomes.label: C
items: Students decode grade-level words with phonics and word analysis and read grade-level texts with accuracy, automaticity, and prosody.
Students identify plot structure, theme, character perspectives, and rhyme schemes in literary texts.
Students explain informational text features, central ideas, author's purpose, and author's opinions with supporting evidence.
Students retell texts, compare important details across two texts, and write narratives, opinions, and expository texts.
Students follow grade-level conventions, research one topic with multiple sources, and use academic vocabulary, affixes, and context clues.
